references.text: The earlier event at Horeb where Moses struck the rock and water came out, which is the background for this event at Meribah.
God's command to Moses to speak to the rock, not strike it, which Moses did not follow.
God's judgment on Moses and Aaron for their disobedience and lack of trust at this rock.
Reference to Meribah-Kadesh where Moses and Aaron acted unfaithfully toward the Lord.
The psalm describes how the people made Moses angry at the waters of Meribah, and how this led him to speak rashly.
Warning against hardening your heart as at Meribah, where your ancestors put God to the test.
Paul refers to the spiritual rock that followed the Israelites in the wilderness and identifies it as Christ.
The author of Hebrews quotes Psalm 95 and warns against hardening your heart as at Meribah.
